name: Hallie Meyers-Shyer
biography: Hallie Meyers-Shyer (born July 26, 1987) is an American actress and filmmaker. The daughter of filmmakers Charles Shyer and Nancy Meyers, she had small roles in several of her parents' films. She made her filmmaking debut in 2017 as the writer and director of the romantic comedy film Home Again. Her second film as writer and director, Goodrich, was released in 2024.
